entry.title: New: dsh-session-manager
entry.summary: DSH session manager: delete with trash/restore/purge, restore archived sessions, recent-activity stats, continue/pause, open log folder, unread markers, fork into a new chat, workspace grouping and sorting, context compaction threshold.
